function: Joint channel estimation, detection, and LDPC decoding of coded MIMO signals with few pilots, outputting the information bits and the channel estimate (p. 1, p. 5).
system: Coded single-carrier MIMO; Gaussian channels Nr=8, Nt=4; mmWave UPAs 2x2 transmit and 8x8 receive; short LDPC (3,6) N=288; no RIS; mmWave band, frequency not stated (p. 9).
method: Deep unfolding of ADMM receivers (JCDDNet-G, JCDDNet-S) with layer-wise trainable parameters; supervised offline training, multi-stage, Adam optimizer (p. 6, p. 10).
data_channel: Own simulators: i.i.d. Gaussian, Kronecker-correlated Gaussian, and Saleh-Valenzuela mmWave channels; 10000 training samples; no 3GPP model or measured data (p. 9, p. 10).
test_conditions: Trained at one SNR, 10000 samples; tested over SNR, then on correlated channels (0.3) and codelength 144 with i.i.d.-trained, codelength-288 parameters (p. 10, p. 13).
baselines: Decoupled, IDD and ICDD turbo receivers with MMSE, GAMP, MAP detectors; MMSE-ICDD with virtual pilot selection [17]; untrained ADMM version; no learned receiver (p. 10, p. 11).
metrics: BLER versus SNR; average iterations or layers and time per codeword; real-valued operation counts and CPU time per codeword (p. 11, p. 14).
complexity: Table I: real-valued operations per codeword (about 1.1e5 per layer, Nr=8, Nt=4); Table II: average CPU time per codeword in MATLAB (p. 14).
openness: Code at https://github.com/sunyi0101/JCDDNet (p. 10, footnote 3); channel data generated by simulation.
q1_support: p. 9: "the Saleh-Valenzuela model is used to generate the mmWave MIMO channel"; Gaussian channels follow the Kronecker model; custom simulators, no 3GPP, COST 2100 or DeepMIMO model and no measured data.
q2_support: p. 13: "directly applying the parameters trained under i.i.d. Gaussian channels for correlated Gaussian channels"; also "directly loaded with the parameters trained for C1 of codelength N = 288 and evaluated with C2 of codelength N = 144".
q3_support: p. 10: "The traditional decoupled and turbo receivers, including the IDD [14], [15] and the ICDD [16], are adopted for performance comparison"; all are non-learned, no earlier learned receiver is compared, and JCDD-G is the untrained variant of the proposed network.
q4_support: p. 14: "the proposed JCDD networks require only 1.1e5 operations per layer"; Table I gives the operations per codeword and Table II the CPU time.
notes: Area 1 because the main metric is BLER (p. 11-13); channel estimation is joint and no channel-estimation error is reported. Deep unfolding with trained parameters counts as learned. q2 counts the direct tests with mismatched correlation and codelength (p. 13), although the paper admits failure for strongly deviated channel distributions (p. 13). Learned receivers DeepRx [23], [24] and [26] are only discussed in the introduction (p. 2), not compared, so q3 is not met.
